description: This file defines the AdminEvaluationController class within the OrangeHRM project. It handles the presentation logic for administering employee performance evaluations, including rendering the evaluation component and access control based on user roles.

classes.name: AdminEvaluationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling display and security logic related to employee performance evaluations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the evaluation component for rendering if an 'id' attribute is set in the request, fetching performance review data and setting properties.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to view the specified performance review, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: setReviewProps
methods.description: Sets properties on the Vue component based on the performance review details.

methods.name: isUserPerformanceReviewEvaluator
methods.description: Determines if the current user is authorized to evaluate the given performance review.
